title: DPDP Act Implementation: MeitY Opens Consent Manager Registration Portal
summary: The IT ministry (MeitY) has opened the registration process for consent managers under the Digital Personal Data Protection (DPDP) Act,…
llm_summary: India’s Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology (MeitY) has launched an online portal for registering “consent managers” under the Digital Personal Data Protection (DPDP) Act. These managers will act as intermediaries that obtain, record and enforce user consent for the collection and processing of personal data, helping businesses comply with the new privacy law.
